QuestInfo.name: Tumbleweed's Return
QuestInfo.0: None of the foxes are saying a word, other than you should ask Moonbeam. Maybe Silver will give you a straight answer.
QuestInfo.1: According to Silver, Tumbleweed the wandering fox is back from his travels. You should go meet him, especially since you moved into his house. Silver seems quite serious, so there must be something more than just his return.
QuestInfo.2: Tumbleweed explains that this world is Grandis, a wholly different world from Maple World. However, they are connected through an interdimensional portal called the Dimensional Gate. This means you've found a way to return to Maple World! No wonder Moonbeam was avoiding you.

0.0: Moonbeam was crying? Ahh, I was afraid of this. She was especially close to you. Well, #r#p3002010##k is back in town. He's the owner of the house you're staying at, remember.
0.1: I suppose we can't keep it a secret from you forever. But Moonbeam is still a child and has a soft heart. I'm sure she couldn't bear to tell you. It'll be best to hear the details from #r#p3002010##k yourself.

yes.0: Ah, don't worry about the house. He's just here to say hello and pick up a few things. I'm sure he'll be going again soon. What you do after you speak to #r#p3002010##k is up to you.

no.0: I am Moonbeam's grandpa, after all. I don't want to tell you things she doesn't want tell you herself.

0.msg: You must be Shade! Earless and tailess, just like everyone said. That makes you #ehuman#n, right? Did you come from #e#rMaple World#k#n?

1.msg: Yes, but how do you know about Maple World? Have you been there? What's it like now?

2.msg: Whoa, slow down. I've never been to Maple World. You can only get there by crossing dimensions. I've met travelers from there... There's a whole bunch of humans in Pantheon, for example. You know about the Interdimensional Portal, right?

3.msg:
The what? No, not at all. I have no idea how I got here. I...

...

...I woke up under the Fox Tree. I thought something must have sent me here.

4.msg: Weird. That's a better story than I can come up with! So, it never occurred to you that you weren't on Maple World anymore?

5.msg: No, I figured that much out myself. Maple World doesn't have two moons, for starters. But, what is this #rDimensional Gate#k thing? Some kind of link between here and Maple World?

6.msg: I'm not really sure. It gives me the willies whenever I get near it. You were probably sent here through a hidden portal, so the real portal is probably your best bet for getting home.

npc.0: Tumbleweed will tell you everything, including what Moonbeam is trying to hide from you.
